resources.string: Which DNS WARP asks for Cloudflare\'s address. Automatic works on most networks; if WARP says it cannot connect, type your internet provider\'s DNS.
DNS server addresses, comma separated, for example 87.101.204.72
Where WARP looks up Cloudflare. Your provider\'s DNS addresses are on your router\'s status page. Leave empty for Automatic (your network\'s DNS plus public ones).
